name: vpype
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: Command-line pipelines that load, transform, optimise and write plotter-ready SVG paths
summary: Python CLI and library for vector path pipelines. Commands chain to read SVG, generate shapes, scale and crop to a page, merge and sort lines, and write SVG or HPGL for pen plotters. Strength is deterministic line geometry processing, with layers and stable output, as a pre-step for plotter work or line-art animation.
use_when: Optimising and layering line art for a pen plotter
Over Inkscape CLI when you need geometry ops: merge, sort, simplify
Pipeline-style SVG line processing in one shell command
Generating frames of line art via a Python API
avoid_when: Filled shapes, gradients or text styling: Inkscape or resvg
Generating art with sketches and noise: vsketch or p5.js
Colour compositing or raster output: ImageMagick
notes: 2026-10-26: Install on macOS arm64 was not tested; some plugins need compiled wheels.

assessment.rationale: 1.15.0 released 2025-08-04, about 15 months before assessment, after 1.14.0 in January 2024. Documentation is current and the tool has no direct neighbour for plotter geometry pipelines.
